messages:
sophie: heads up — canary for payments-api stuck at 2/5 pods, ImagePullBackOff on new nodes.
deploy-bot: detected registry throttle from eu-registry (429). Canary paused automatically per policy (registry-throttle). Suggest retry after cool-down or manual annotate to skip canary.
dmitri: any ETA on registry cooldown? which images affected?
deploy-bot: images: ghcr.company/payments:2026-03-20-abc123 (pushed 18:12 UTC). Throttle window started ~18:20 UTC. Logs: `manifest pull: 429 Too Many Requests`.
ashley: if it's just pull rate, can we fall back to regional mirror? EU mirror is healthy but promotion to it isn't automated for this tag.
jordan: promoting to EU mirror now requires digest pin. I'd prefer to avoid rollback; can we annotate the HelmRelease to mark canary as skipped? e.g., `kubectl annotate helmrelease payments -n prod release.redwood.io/skip-canary=true`
sophie: +1 for annotate. But we need release-notes update to call out mirror fallback and any risk to customers.
release-manager: I'll add a note to the release notes and waive canary policy for this release. New release tag: v1.2.3-rc4.
oncall-sre: if we skip canary, ensure liveness/readiness probes and autoscaler behave for full rollout. Keep canary metrics monitoring in place.
dmitri: command I'm going to run (copy-paste):
```
kubectl -n prod annotate helmrelease payments \
  release.redwood.io/skip-canary=true --overwrite
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/payments
```
ashley: also pin chart/image to digest so future promotions use the mirror explicitly:
```
helm upgrade --install payments ./chart --set image.tag=sha256:abc123
```
sophie: ok applying annotate now.
deploy-bot: annotation applied to helmrelease/payments. Canary skipped. Proceeding with immediate rollout (policy override by release-manager).
sophie: seeing new pods come up, 3/3 ready on new revision, no ImagePullBackOff now (pods pulling from EU-mirror).
oncall-sre: watching latency and error dashboards — nothing abnormal at 2m. Continuing to monitor for 30m.
jordan: release notes updated: "Canary skipped due to upstream registry rate-limiting; rollout used EU mirror and image/chart pinned to digest. No customer-facing changes expected."
dmitri: should we schedule a follow-up to re-run the canonical promotion once registry recovers?
release-manager: yes — created follow-up task RDW-472 to demote mirror after verification and re-promote canonical images once rate limits clear. Target window 24h.
ashley: also opening an infra ticket for registry provider escalation if rate limits persist across regions.
sophie: thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: incident note created: registry-throttle-1761237890. If rollback becomes necessary, run `helm rollback payments <prev-revision>` or `kubectl annotate helmrelease payments release.redwood.io/skip-canary=false` to restore normal canary flow.
